outline: This semester shifts focus from static textbook scenarios to the rapidly evolving world of Artificial Intelligence. Each week, we will analyze current events, news articles, and authentic media (podcasts/videos) related to how AI is reshaping society, ethics, and the field of Computer Science. Students will develop advanced English skills through debate, critical summary, and technical communication.
